description: Create a stream card and get ingest server addresses for RTMP, SRT or WHIP (browser). A stream card has no planned start time: it goes on air when start_stream is called. The stream key is hidden; call reveal_stream_key when the user wants it. visibility chooses who can watch: Access modes: PUBLIC (anyone, listed on the channel), LINK_ONLY (anyone who has the link or the embed code, not listed), REGISTERED (viewer must fill the registration form), ACCESS_KEY (viewer must enter a password), PRIVATE (only the owner). For an internal or staff-only broadcast use ACCESS_KEY together with access_key (the password viewers enter), or REGISTERED. Default PUBLIC. Next steps for a website: get_stream_embed_codes for the player and chat iframes, set_embed_domains to restrict them to the company site, start_stream when the encoder is sending.

access_key.description: The password viewers must enter. Required when visibility is ACCESS_KEY, ignored otherwise. Change it later with update_stream.

recording.description: Default true: each broadcast is kept as a recording on this stream card (downloadable later; not a separate video). false keeps nothing after the broadcast.

visibility.description: Access mode; the five modes are listed in create_stream

name: create_stream
title: Create a stream
